content.text:
**The streak rules aren’t shown inside the app yet.** The flame is display-only, so tapping it does nothing. Currently:

- A day adds 1 when you block any time or keep a daily limit without skipping or unlocking it.
- Only missed scheduled days can break the streak.
- Weekly passes automatically forgive misses: 0 for one scheduled day, 1 for two or three, 2 for four or more.
- After passes run out, a 30-minute Quick Start can rescue a miss during the following two calendar days.
- Vacation days preserve your streak; blocking time during vacation can still add days.

**8:30 AM was just an example in the testing instructions.** The welcome-back message never mentions a block’s start time. It says:

> Welcome back. Your scheduled blocks are on again.

Its delivery time depends on your actual schedules for the return day:

| First block starts | Message arrives |
|---|---|
| 8:30 AM | 7:30 AM |
| 10:00 AM | 9:00 AM |
| No block that day | 9:00 AM |

Ending vacation manually cancels that message.

**Test 9 checks the streak rescue alert.** Imagine you already have a streak, have no weekly passes left, and completely miss Monday’s block.

On Tuesday, open the app before 9:00 AM. At 9:00, it should warn that your streak is at risk. Complete a 30-minute Quick Start on Tuesday or Wednesday to save it.

The test asks you to switch the phone off during Monday’s block because even a few seconds of blocked time would make Monday count. The amber dot should disappear when you start the rescue; let the Quick Start finish so the rescue remains valid.
